 since the same chunk the `clippy` leg runs a second line only when the workspace line is green, upstream's own `cargo clippy -p blitz-dom --no-default-features --features svg,woff,accessibility,system-fonts,file-input,custom-widget --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings`, and the `stand-repeat` leg holds the stand checks to a zero-failure budget over three rounds (.github/scripts/ci-leg.sh:21-25; .github/scripts/ci-leg.sh:48-65); and, since 2026-10-16-fast-failing-mutants, a mutation tier run on the dev host alone, never in CI: cargo-mutants 27.1.0, the tier's tool, with `--test-tool nextest` and `--baseline=skip`, and cargo-nextest 0.9.146, its test tool, under the `mutants` profile of the root `.config/nextest.toml` (fail-fast at the first failure, four test threads, one priority override naming the direct tests; the default profile untouched), each unit's mutant test command read green on the unmutated tree first — neither tool lockfile-resolved, the profile selected by `NEXTEST_PROFILE=mutants`, a host tool's variable no workspace source reads (dev host, as measured at escher-0.2.0/chunks/2026-10-16-fast-failing-mutants/report.md; the recipe in test-plan §10)
